metric: Global network capacity, as published on the Magic Transit product page
networkNote: 534 Tbps of global network capacity, published on Cloudflare's Magic Transit page.
notes: Primary official product page explicitly refers to the Cloudflare global network and publishes 534 Tbps of network capacity, with no figure-specific date or further metric definition. It does not explicitly call the 534 Tbps number external interconnection or scrubbing capacity. Separately, Cloudflare's April 10, 2026 engineering post defines its then-current 500 Tbps milestone as provisioned external interconnection ports facing transit, private peering, IXs and CNI; that older definition must not be transferred automatically to the 534 Tbps claim. Some older official pages retain smaller figures. Do not relabel 534 Tbps as simultaneous content-delivery throughput or a measured DDoS attack size.
